name: snarl-sopi-backend
description: Snarl and Sopi operator backend v6.45.0: email receipts for fridge customers. POST /machines/:deviceCode/fridge/receipt sends an operator-branded receipt (name, kennitala, contact, logo, lines, total, VSK per rate) in the customer's language, reply-to the operator. The address is held in memory only until sent. Config gains receipts.enabled (operator has name + kennitala); operator edits now bump their machines' config. Cumulative over v6.44.1.
